ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) regions localized to the distal tips and sporadic interior points, representing approximately 15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central mass. High-intensity mottling and contiguous white patches are mapped to the distal extremities of both lobes. Localized circular high-intensity clusters are visible in the mid-section of the left lobe and near the lower central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant depth penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude visible along the entire continuous trailing edge; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory on the trailing edge sweeping from the distal tips toward the median notch, characterized by local geometric irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters; one prominent ring-shaped 'donut' scar on the left mid-lobe and several smaller white clusters scattered in the low-intensity regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, elongated diagonal linear pixel disruption is visible on the left lobe, cutting through the natural pigmentation mapping from the lower leading edge toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged and irregular distal lobe tips with significant pixel-level jaggedness; presence of numerous circular attachment scars and at least one distinct rake-like linear mark.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast white patches at the lateral tips that transition into a speckled or 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern as they meet the central black pigmentation.
